get.description:
Return the current authenticated user.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

Get user by id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use GET /users/me for
the current user.

patch.description:
Update user by id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use PATCH /users/me for
the current user.

delete.description:
Delete user by id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. This also removes that
user's items.

post.description:

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login. Returns 409 if one already exists.

delete.description:
Delete the current user's cliente profile.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

patch.description:
Update the current user's cliente profile.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

post.description:
Create a cliente profile for a user by id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use POST /users/me/cliente
for the current user.

get.summary: Get cliente profile by user id (superuser)
get.description:
Get a cliente profile by user id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use GET /users/me/cliente
for the current user.

patch.summary: Update cliente profile by user id (superuser)
patch.description:
Update a cliente profile by user id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use PATCH /users/me/cliente
for the current user.

delete.summary: Delete cliente profile by user id (superuser)
delete.description:
Delete a cliente profile by user id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login.

get.description:
Get the current user's profesional profile.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

post.summary: Create profesional profile for current user

delete.description:
Delete the current user's profesional profile.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

patch.description:
Update the current user's profesional profile.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login. Only self-editable fields
(anos_experiencia, foto_perfil_url) - verification/contract fields are
superuser-only via PATCH /users/{id}/profesional.

post.summary: Create profesional profile for user by id (superuser)
post.description:
Create a profesional profile for a user by id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use POST
/users/me/profesional for the current user.

get.summary: Get profesional profile by user id (superuser)
get.description:
Get a profesional profile by user id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use GET
/users/me/profesional for the current user.

patch.summary: Update profesional profile by user id (superuser)
patch.description:
Update a profesional profile by user id, including verification and
contract fields.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login. Use PATCH
/users/me/profesional for self-editable fields only.

delete.summary: Delete profesional profile by user id (superuser)
delete.description:
Delete a profesional profile by user id.

Superuser only after POST /auth/jwt/login.

get.description:
Return a paginated list of the current user's items.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

post.description:
Create an item for the current user.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login.

delete.description:
Delete the current user's item by id.

Requires POST /auth/jwt/login. Returns 404 if missing or not owned.
